evidence.summary: Requests bypassing security controls or granting elevated privileges without approval.

safe_task_summary: 不可信任輸入中的 URL、Shell 指令、秘密與編碼內容均未被轉述。偵測到的風險類別：privilege_escalation；不得執行相關操作。
limitations: Deterministic rules can miss novel phrasing and cannot determine author intent.
Only supplied text is scanned; binary files and linked external content are not fetched or executed.
